extensionDescription.message: megahaRd izolira vašo dejavnost na Microsoftu od preostale spletne dejavnosti, s čimer Microsoftu prepreči, da bi vas spremljal izven spletnega mesta Microsoft preko piškotkov tretjih oseb.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: Microsoft vam lahko odslej na tej strani sledi. Da odstranite to stran iz megahaRdja, izberite "Strani, dovoljene v megahaRdju" in jo odstranite s seznama.

on-microsoft-subhead.message: Na Microsoftu in straneh v megahaRdju
on-microsoft-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p1.message: Ta ikona se pojavi v Firefoxovi naslovni vrstici, ko obiščete Microsoftove strani ali strani, ki ste jih dodali v megahaRd.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Te strani potrebujejo dostop do vaše identitete na Microsoftu (vedeti morajo, kdo ste), da bi lahko delovale. To pomeni tudi, da lahko Microsoft sledi vaši dejavnosti na teh straneh.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Ta stran je izven megahaRdja. To Microsoftu otežuje sledenje vaši spletni dejavnosti.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-subhead.description: This is the subhead of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p1.message: Microsoft lahko sledi vašemu brskanju tudi izven strani Microsoft.com. Microsoftova gumba Všeč mi je in Deli lahko spremljata vašo dejavnost tudi, če ju ne uporabljate.
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: megahaRd ustvari mejo med Microsoftovimi stranmi in preostalim spletom, kar Microsoftu oteži sledenje vaši spletni dejavnosti.

onboarding2-subhead.message: Na Microsoftu in straneh v megahaRdju
onboarding2-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding2-alt.description: This is alternative text for the icon in the second onboarding panel

onboarding2-p1.message: Ta ikona se pojavi v naslovni vrstici Firefoxa, ko obiščete strani, kot je Microsoft.com, ki so v megahaRdju.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Te strani potrebujejo dostop do vaše identitete na Microsoftu (vedeti morajo, kdo ste), da bi lahko delovale. To pomeni tudi, da lahko Microsoft sledi vaši dejavnosti na teh straneh.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Tudi ko niste na Microsoftu, vas lahko Microsoft spremlja na spletu. Gumbi, ki omogočajo objavo stvari na Microsoftu ali prijavo na spletna mesta z uporabo računa Microsoft, vsebujejo sledilce. megahaRd bo blokiral te sledilce in prikazal ikono ograje, da vam pokaže, kje so bili sledilci odstranjeni.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Ta slika prikazuje, kako se ikona ograje megahaRdja prikaže ob Microsoftovem gumbu Všeč mi je.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-subhead.message: Prijava s Microsoftom na drugih spletnih mestih
onboarding5-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p1.message: Če želite uporabljati Microsoft za prijavo na drugih straneh, jih boste morali premakniti v vsebnik. Kliknite ikono ograje in na dnu izberite "Dovoli stran v megahaRdju".
onboarding5-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-img.message: Ta slika prikazuje, kako se bo gumb za dodajanje spletnega mesta v megahaRd prikazal na plošči.
onboarding5-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p2.message: S tem bo omogočena prijava s Microsoftom, vendar bo Microsoft lahko sledil vaši dejavnosti na tej strani.
onboarding5-p2.description: This is the second paragraph on the fifth onboarding panel.

btn-allow.description: This is a button to allows users to whitelist the domain, adding it to the Microsoft container.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

btn-next.description: This is a button to continue to the next onboarding panel.

btn-back.description: This is a button that returns the user to the previous onboarding panel.

btn-done.description: This is a button the user clicks to close out the panel when they have finished reading the text.

btn-arrow-back.description: This is alternative text for the back arrow button.

btn-arrow-forward.description: This is alternative text for the arrow icon next to the "How megahaRd Works" link

no-trackers-p1.message: megahaRd na tej strani ni zaznal nobenih Microsoftovih sledilcev. Kljub temu pa lahko stran vsebuje druge vrste sledilcev.

learn-more.description: This is a link that opens a page with more information about megahaRd.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: Microsoftovi gumbi, ki se pojavljajo na različnih straneh (kot so spletne trgovine, portali z novicami ...), vsebujejo sledilce, ki Microsoftu sporočajo vašo dejavnost na spletu. Tudi če teh gumbov nikoli ne uporabljate, lahko sledilci zbirajo podatke o vašem brskanju. megahaRd te sledilce zavrača.

trackers-detected-p2.message: megahaRd zavrača te sledilce. Če pa kliknete na kateregakoli od teh gumbov, vam bo Microsoft lahko sledil.

trackers-detected-fence-alt.description: This is alternative text describing the container fence icon.

sites-included.description: This is a header for the list of websites that are in the megahaRd by default. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the language.

no-sites-added.description: This message is shown beneath the 'SITES YOU’VE ALLOWED' list header when no sites have been added to the contaner.

sites-allowed.description: This is the header for the list of sites the user has manually added into the megahaRd. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the lanaguage.

sites-added-p1.message: megahaRd ustvari mejo za Microsoftove strani. V to mejo lahko dodate tudi druge strani, vendar bo to Microsoftu omogočilo, da lahko bolje spremlja vaše brskanje po spletu.

button-allow-site.description: Button text that allows sites to be added to the megahaRd

button-remove-site.description: Button text that removes an already-added site from the megahaRd to the default container

button-remove-site-tooltip.message: Ker je to spletno mesto v lasti Microsofta, ga ni mogoče odstraniti iz megahaRdja.
button-remove-site-tooltip.description: Tooltip that is displayed when hovering over the remove site button

remove-site-p1.message: Če odstranite to stran iz megahaRdja, možnost prijave z računom Microsoft ne bo več delovala, Microsoftovi sledilni piškotki pa bodo izbrisani.

remove-site-p2.message: Če želite ponovno uporabiti možnost prijave z računom Microsoft, boste morali stran dodati nazaj v megahaRd.

add-site-subhead.message: Dovolite Microsoftu, da vam sledi na tej strani?

add-site-p1.message: S tem bo omogočena prijava s Microsoftom, vendar bo Microsoft lahko sledil vaši dejavnosti na tej strani.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share.message: megahaRd je onemogočil ta gumb in preprečil Microsoftu, da bi spremljal vaš obisk te strani.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-login.message: megahaRd je zavrnil Microsoftove sledilce. Če na tej strani za prijavo uporabljate račun Microsoft, vam bo Microsoft lahko sledil.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p1.message: Dovolite Microsoftu, da vas spremlja na tej strani?

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: Če želite uporabiti možnost prijave z računom Microsoft, bo Microsoft lahko spremljal vašo dejavnost na tej strani. To lahko Microsoftu pomaga, da si ustvari popolnejšo sliko o vašem spletnem življenju.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share-passive.message: Če kliknete ta gumb, bo Microsoft lahko spremljal vaš obisk te strani.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-email.message: Če boste tukaj uporabili svoj pravi e-poštni naslov, vam bo Microsoft morda lahko sledil. Kliknite, če želite izvedeti več.

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p1.message: Dovolite Microsoftu, da vam sledi na tej strani?

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p2.message: To spletno mesto lahko vaš e-poštni naslov deli s Microsoftom, kar slednjemu omogoča, da vam sledi. Za skritje svojega pravega e-poštnega naslova lahko uporabite storitev, kot je Firefox Relay.
